# MM-P2-L2-IH01 - Maintenance manual - Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P2, line P2-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-IH01

Scope
- Routine maintenance and operational verification for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P2-L2-IH01). Applies to mechanical, electrical, and cooling systems associated with the unit. Refer to ECN-2026-012 and ECN-2026-048 for design changes and SOP-P2-L2-05 for standard operating procedures.

Tools
- Basic insulated hand tools, multimeter, clamp meter, vibration pickup, thermal camera, and water flow meter calibrated per plant practice. Use PPE as required by SOP-P2-L2-05.

Procedure
- Isolate power and lockout/tagout per SOP-P2-L2-05 before access. Verify LOTO status with multimeter.
- Visually inspect coil assembly and buswork for signs of damage, discoloration, or loose connections. Address findings in accordance with ECN-2026-012.
- Inspect cooling water supply and return lines for leaks, erosion, and proper routing. Clean strainers and verify unobstructed flow path.
- Measure coil cooling water flow with the calibrated flow meter. Confirm coil cooling water flow minimum for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P2-L2-IH01) is 81 L/min. Record measured value on the maintenance log and attach to the work order.
- Power-up following SOP-P2-L2-05 and perform a controlled heat sequence. Use thermal camera and process indicators to confirm uniform heating.
- Confirm the target billet temperature for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P2-L2-IH01) is 1230 °C during process validation runs. Record temperature verification and any deviations.
- Restore panels, remove LOTO, and return unit to service per SOP-P2-L2-05.

Acceptance criteria
- No active electrical faults or abnormal vibration signatures present after maintenance. 
- Coil cooling water flow meets or exceeds 81 L/min as recorded. 
- Billet heating achieves and sustains 1230 °C during validation checks. 
- All findings documented and corrective actions tracked; design discrepancies referenced to ECN-2026-048.
